text:
```yaml
name: Codex Review - Notify Code Owner
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - epic
      - develop
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - labeled
jobs:
  test-ui-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Vitest tests for UI regression coverage
        run: npm run test:unit -- --run --reporter=verbose

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        if: always()
        with:
          artifact: test-results
          name: Vitest Test Results
          path: '*.xml'
          reporter: jest-junit
          working-directory: .
```
